description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: The Washington Council of Police & Sheriffs (WACOPS), the largest law enforcement association in the state, has endorsed Drew Stokesbary in his campaign for State Representative. In its endorsement, WACOPS expressed appreciation for Stokesbary’s “support of public safety and law enforcement officers.” “Protecting public safety is a core function of our government,” … Continued
